summary: postinstall sideloads undeclared sibling package randompkgb
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle hook `rnpm i randompkgb` that installs a package not present in the declared dependency tree. The tarball is otherwise hollow: `main` points to an index.js that is not shipped, so the package has no library behavior and the sole effect of `npm install` is to pull and execute code from the undeclared sibling `randompkgb` outside lockfile/audit visibility. Author metadata is blank. This is the dependency-graph-hijack lure shape: installing this package resolves to and executes attacker-controlled code from a sibling not reviewed by the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
